cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Process Engineering Manager to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:
Elevate process efficiency to meet or exceed standard cost expectations.
Reduce scrap and material usage variance to below 5%.
Spearhead continuous improvement projects, targeting a 2% annual cost saving.
Maintain or surpass OSHA safety standards.
Lead projects aimed at increasing revenue, minimizing expenses, and optimizing business processes for better customer satisfaction.
Innovate by applying new techniques and technologies to resolve challenges.
Mentor team members on complex problem-solving and decision-making processes.
Provide technical leadership across the organization, enhancing existing and new processes.
Ensure timely, cost-effective project progress, aligning with plans and objectives.
Smoothly transition processes from development to commercialization.
Offer expert process improvement advice to customers.
Oversee design and development of new products, refining production techniques and testing procedures.
Manage department budgeting and operational forecasting.
Talent Management:
Deliver regular feedback, fostering a culture of success and professional development.
Supervise and mentor Process Engineering team members, ensuring alignment with organizational policies and goals.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field.
Over 10 years of engineering experience, including 3-5 years in management.
Strong analytical skills and ability to manage complex information.
Proficient in project management, blueprint reading, GD&T, SPC, MSA, DOE, and advanced statistical and mathematical analysis.
Experienced in injection molding, metal fabrication, and medical device manufacturing.
Preferred Requirements:
Master's degree in Engineering or related field.
PMP certification.
Competent in Minitab and MS Office Suite.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Competent in Minitab and MS Office Suite.

Master's degree in Engineering or related field.
PMP certification.

cond_0079.intro: We are looking for a Process Engineering Manager to join our team.
cond_0079.responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:
Improve process efficiency to meet or exceed standard cost expectations.
Reduce scrap and material usage variance to below 5%.
Lead continuous improvement projects targeting a 2% annual cost saving.
Maintain or surpass OSHA safety standards.
Manage projects aimed at increasing revenue, minimizing expenses, and optimizing business processes for better customer satisfaction.
Apply new techniques and technologies to resolve technical challenges.
Mentor team members on complex problem-solving and decision-making processes.
Provide technical guidance on existing and new processes across the organization.
Ensure timely, cost-effective project progress in line with plans and objectives.
Transition processes from development to commercialization.
Provide process improvement input to customers as required.
Oversee design and development of new products, refining production techniques and testing procedures.
Manage department budgeting and operational forecasting.

Deliver feedback to support professional development and alignment with organizational goals.
Supervise and mentor Process Engineering team members, ensuring alignment with organizational policies and goals.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field.
Over 10 years of engineering experience, including 3-5 years in management.
Strong analytical skills and ability to manage complex information.
Proficient in project management, blueprint reading, GD&T, SPC, MSA, DOE, and advanced statistical and mathematical analysis.
Experienced in injection molding, metal fabrication, and medical device manufacturing.
Competent in Minitab and MS Office Suite.
Preferred Requirements:
Master's degree in Engineering or related field.
PMP certification.
